description: Ten-row student update that moves every child to another city and its pickup to a later time; the preceding create is not measured. Unchanged rows cost the same today, because every matched row is rewritten. Measured by TestStudentImportUpdateAndUpsertBatchQueryBudget after two warmups (ADR 0067 addendum 2026-11-08, Messplan N10/N110). The batch path writes each row without a row savepoint, because a failed row aborts its whole chunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 3).
